entities.summary: Valentin Vasylyovych Silvestrov is a Ukrainian composer and pianist who plays and writes contemporary classical music. He is a laureate of Shevchenko National Prize. Valentyn Sylvestrov was a composers & musicians from Kyiv (b. 1937-09-30, Kyiv). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
